description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 2137/22 of 19.08.2019 - Cad. Map No. 520214
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing corrections and updates to land parcel details, ownership interests, and property encumbrances. The content focuses entirely on land and property matters, including specific land parcel numbers, cadastral maps, extent measurements, and life interest provisions, which falls squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4).
